name: vuesp.kc868-a6
summary: KinCony KC868-A6 controller with 6 inputs, 6 outputs and RTC support.
description:
## Vuesp KC868-A6

ESP32 firmware for the KinCony KC868-A6 board. Six digital inputs and six relay outputs are handled over I2C, and the onboard RTC is used for timekeeping.

ScriptRunner exposes `input` and `output` functions, and the dashboard contains buttons for all six channels. The project includes the standard Vuesp Wi-Fi setup, LittleFS, GPIO and OTA features.
